title: MIP Error Response
description: The shared error body shape used throughout the spec (Appendix B). Status codes listed there are RECOMMENDED, not part of this body schema.

error.description: A short machine-readable error code, e.g. invalid_challenge, verification_failed, invalid_request, rate_limited, upstream_unavailable, already_linked (§10.2). Not a closed enum — an RP MAY define additional error codes.
